display_name: The Blood of the Old Kings
description: P33 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, decision 22): once the giant stands at stage 4 without an ancestry, the shrines of the Old Kingdom offer it one - Stoneblood, Stormborn or Wildheart, chosen once on a shrine's Ancestry tab. The objective leads to the nearest shrine the giant has already reached (an unreached shrine's marker is dropped). Optional: not part of the main thread (the XP budget does not count its 30 XP).

stages.objective: Choose your ancestry at a shrine
stages.waiting_text: Rest at a shrine of the Old Kingdom and open its Ancestry tab.
